plan.oneLiner: A cozy, chaotic burger-stacking game. Free, and no ads.
plan.audience: Casual puzzle players, mostly 16–35, who play in short breaks and are tired of games that interrupt them with ads.

pillars.name: No ads
pillars.why: Players hate ads in free games. "Free and no ads" is rare and easy to remember, so it goes in every post.

pillars.name: Satisfying stacks
pillars.why: Tall wobbly towers and near-topples make people watch to the end.

pillars.name: Cute, demanding customers
pillars.why: Grumpy VIPs and flies give each clip a tiny story.

channels.name: TikTok
channels.note: Main channel. Post the same vertical video here first.

channels.name: Instagram Reels
channels.note: Repost the TikTok video (without the TikTok watermark: use the original file).

channels.name: YouTube Shorts
channels.note: Same video again. Shorts keep getting views for months.

plan.cadence: 3 posts a week. Before launch, the link in your bio goes to the free web version. After launch, it goes to the App Store.
tips: Add an upbeat trending sound inside TikTok before posting. The clips are silent on purpose so you can.
Reply to comments with a new video. It's the easiest way to get a second post out of one.
Don't pay for ads yet. Paid ads start after launch, once Studio shows each player earns more than they cost.

posts.title: The lunch rush
posts.hook: POV: the lunch rush just hit
posts.caption: every customer wants it EXACTLY their way 🍔 free game, zero ads. link in bio

posts.title: The VIP
posts.hook: He tips double. He has zero patience.
posts.caption: the VIPs in this game are ruthless 😤 would you survive the rooftop grill? (free, no ads, link in bio)

posts.title: Don't let it topple
posts.caption: 8 layers at midnight. my hands were shaking 😭 free game, no ads, link in bio

posts.title: "I made a game with no ads"
posts.hook: I made a mobile game with no ads. On purpose.
posts.caption: tired of watching a 30 second ad every time you lose? me too. so i made crumbstack. free, no ads. link in bio
posts.note: Talking-head style works best: film yourself saying the hook for 3 seconds, then cut to this clip. Use TikTok's green-screen effect if you'd rather not be on camera.

posts.title: Rate my burger
posts.caption: be honest. is 8 layers too many? 🍔 (free game, no ads, link in bio)
posts.note: Questions in the hook get comments, and comments push the video to more people.

posts.title: Three worlds
posts.caption: diner, rooftop grill, or midnight food truck? 🍔🌇🌙 free game, no ads, link in bio
posts.note: No clip yet: screen-record the level map on your phone (Control Center → Screen Recording) and scroll from world 1 to world 3.

paidLater.name: Apple Search Ads
paidLater.note: Ads at the top of App Store search for words like 'burger game' and 'cooking game'. Start small (about $5/day) after launch.

paidLater.name: TikTok Spark Ads
paidLater.note: Pay to boost a post that's already doing well on its own. Only boost winners.
